title: Knockglass, Ladysbridge, Ladysbridge, Co. Cork
description:
Set amidst beautifully landscaped grounds in one of East Cork's most picturesque locations, Weathering Heights is a truly distinguished family residence where timeless elegance meets contemporary country living. Hidden behind electric gates and surrounded by mature gardens, this remarkable home enjoys breathtaking views stretching across Youghal Bay, offering a lifestyle defined by space, privacy and understated luxury.

Extending to an impressive 297.61 sq.m., the residence offers wonderfully balanced accommodation perfectly suited to modern living. The heart of the home is an exquisite bespoke kitchen, centred around a traditional fitted AGA, creating a warm and welcoming gathering place. A generous dining area flows effortlessly from the kitchen, while a separate, fully shelved walk-in pantry provides exceptional practicality without compromising on style.

Two elegant reception rooms offer versatile spaces for both relaxed evenings and sophisticated entertaining. Large windows frame the surrounding gardens and flood the interiors with natural light, creating an effortless connection between inside and out.
The ground floor is home to five beautifully proportioned bedrooms, providing superb flexibility for those of every stage. Two luxurious en-suite bedrooms offer peaceful retreats, while the remaining accommodation is equally generous in scale. Upstairs, two additional rooms present endless possibilities ideal as further bedrooms, a private home office, a creative studio, a cinema room or a children's retreat.

This is an exquisite home that offers pace in abundance and a healthy lifestyle. Viewings are now available by calling our Midleton office on 0214639557. Please have references available on request
